tasks.short: Create and modify geographic maps and graphics

steps.what: Select actual geographic layers and verify their coordinate systems, coverage, dates, elevation units and intended scale
outputs: checked map inputs and transformation specification

steps.what: Run the specified repeated layer reprojection, clipping and joins and assemble the draft map layers
inputs: checked map inputs and transformation specification

steps.what: Check transformed geometry and choose the actual cartographic representation, scale, classes and labels
inputs: checked map inputs and transformation specification

steps.what: Create or modify the actual map, graph or diagram layout and check legend, scale, provenance and label placement
outputs: checked working map or geographic graphic

steps.what: Save the ordinary working geographic project in the same mapping environment
inputs: checked working map or geographic graphic

tasks.design: Store the specified repeated layer operations as a batch in {OTHER}, the geographic information and cartographic system. Reuse a native layout for fixed legend and provenance fields while the geographer checks geometry and makes cartographic choices.
tasks.previous_blocker: Map updates can repeat manual command setup and placement of fixed layout elements.
tasks.enabler_now: Explicit transformation chains and native layout fields can perform those repeated actions.
tasks.still_hard: Coordinate errors, scale effects and misleading classification can make a plausible map wrong.
tasks.human_edge: The geographer judges whether the visual representation supports the intended interpretation.

ambition.what: Compare additional checked spatial scenarios at appropriate scales.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: specified geographic transformation chains and layout fields can remove repeated map-production actions while cartographic interpretation remains human.

assumptions: Boundary ends with the actual working map, not publication or operative spatial decisions. Any actual map release needs its real final-version authority and separate action.

s1 selects and verifies actual layer metadata and defines the transformations; no free clean new spatial dataset is presumed. Actual source production belongs to its real collection task and is counted once.

Test existing geographic batch tools and templates first. Native reprojection computation and rendering runtime earn zero new gain; s2 prices only currently manual repeated command setup/assembly, not machine runtime.
s4 removes5.8 of29 fixed legend/provenance layout units;23.2 remain for actual label placement and map checking. s3 retains geometry checks and upkeep includes failed transformation repair.
Save1 is negligible, fully retained and ungated without author approval. Shares are unmeasured work estimates.
research_questions: Which map-update actions remain manual beyond the current batch and layout tools?

already_counted.description: Actual source checks, geometry/cartographic judgment and substantive map layout checking remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain layer-operation and layout mappings and repair failed transformations.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R69.2 gives gross30.8 less upkeep4, net26.8. Low: mixed coordinate metadata retain22 of25 transformation-setup units and an unusual output scale retains26 of29 layout units;3 plus3 saved less4 upkeep gives2. Geometry and cartographic choice remain full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Gather and compile geographic source data

steps.what: Identify the actual geographic question and select census, imagery, field and map sources with their access and coverage constraints
Gather the actual selected source files and field observations and verify identifiers, dates, provenance and spatial reference
outputs: captured and checked geographic source material

steps.what: Compile the selected geographic files into the specified project layer structure using explicit identifier, unit and coordinate mappings
inputs: captured and checked geographic source material

steps.what: Check the compiled layers against sources and write the actual dataset metadata used in subsequent analysis
inputs: captured and checked geographic source material

steps.what: Save the ordinary working dataset and metadata in the same project workspace

tasks.design: Compile actual selected geographic sources through explicit import mappings in {OTHER}, the geographic information and source-catalogue system. Native metadata fields in {DOCS} and the project workspace place source identifiers while the geographer gathers real observations and checks coverage and compatibility.
tasks.previous_blocker: Source compilation can repeat file placement, identifier mapping and metadata copying.
tasks.enabler_now: Explicit source mappings and native metadata fields support those defined transformations.
tasks.still_hard: Different source dates, geographic units and observation methods may not be comparable.
tasks.human_edge: The geographer identifies when combining available sources would create a false comparison.

ambition.what: Compile additional genuinely compatible source combinations.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: explicit geographic source mappings can reduce compilation and metadata copying while field collection and source comparability checks remain human.

assumptions: s1 creates the actual source plan and explicit mappings; s2 counts actual acquisition, field observation capture and source verification. Existing census and imagery production is external work, not free new focal-role capture.
The task covers actual gathering as well as compilation; field work30 remains full. No new mandatory data entry is priced as an existing baseline.
s3 prices only actual manual project compilation, not existing native download/import computation. Test current source connectors first; existing automation earns zero new gain.

s4 removes6 of24 repeated source-identifier/date/coordinate metadata placement units and retains18 for actual compilation checks and limitation writing. Upkeep includes failed schema/coordinate repair.
Metadata are actually used in later analysis. Save1 is negligible, fully retained and ungated. Actual data release needs its real final-version authority and separate action. Shares are unmeasured.
research_questions: Which compilation and metadata actions remain manual after native connectors?

already_counted.description: Actual source planning, gathering/field capture and substantive compilation/metadata checks remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain source/metadata mappings and repair incompatible compilation cases.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R69 gives gross31 less upkeep4, net27. Low: historical census boundaries and imagery dates require manual alignment, retaining19 of25 compilation units and21 of24 metadata/checking units;6 plus3 saved less4 upkeep gives5. Field acquisition remains full.

steps.what: Prepare the actual geography lesson and locate the map passages and examples needed for the learners
Teach the actual geography lesson, demonstrate maps and respond to learners' questions and reasoning

tasks.design: Link the actual map examples in {OTHER}, the geographic teaching/mapping environment, to lesson references in {DOCS} and {LMS}. The geographer retains substantive preparation and live teaching.
tasks.previous_blocker: Locating a relevant map passage can repeat navigation across existing teaching resources.
tasks.enabler_now: Native example links remove retrieval without changing the teaching judgment.
tasks.still_hard: Learners misunderstand scales, spatial patterns and causal claims in different ways.
tasks.human_edge: The geographer recognizes misconceptions and changes the explanation in response.

ambition.what: No automated teaching or learner evaluation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: lesson-to-map links can shorten resource retrieval while responsive geography teaching remains human.

assumptions: Boundary is actual lesson preparation and live teaching, not a new curriculum-development project. No attendance or class-progress report is invented where nobody keeps or reads it.
s1 counts actual objective/context reading and preparation; the link removes3 of15 map-example navigation units and retains12 for actual preparation. Existing native links earn zero new gain.
Any actual grading, written feedback or material publication requires its real separate work and final-version authority/action. Shares are unmeasured estimates.
research_questions: Is there repeated example retrieval beyond the actual preparation work?

already_counted.description: Substantive lesson preparation and actual teaching/demonstration remain counted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R97 gives gross3 less upkeep1, net2. Low: a new local map example lacks reusable passage metadata, retaining14 of15 preparation units;1 saved covers1 upkeep, net0. Live teaching remains full.

tasks.short: Write and present geographic research findings

steps.what: Read and verify the actual geographic research findings, source versions and intended audience
outputs: checked report evidence and audience context

steps.what: Assemble the selected actual maps, figures, tables and source-reference fields into the research report structure
inputs: checked report evidence and audience context

steps.what: Write the report's actual findings narrative and explanation of spatial uncertainty and limitations
inputs: checked report evidence and audience context

loop.purpose: Suggest findings prose from actual maps, tables and research notes
loop.input: Checked geographic evidence, report structure and audience context
loop.output: Draft findings prose with exact source pointers
loop.check: Geographer checks every spatial claim, quantity, source and uncertainty statement in s4
loop.stop: Two drafts then unsupported prose is removed and remaining writing stays manual
loop.why_not_simpler: Fixed assembly handles s2 but explaining the actual geographic findings requires semantic writing

steps.what: Check and correct the complete report's maps, figures, narrative, references and presentation claims
inputs: checked report evidence and audience context
outputs: checked final geographic report for oral presentation

steps.what: Present the actual research findings orally and respond to the audience's questions
inputs: checked final geographic report for oral presentation

tasks.design: Assemble actual maps and tables from {OTHER}, the geographic analysis environment, into {DOCS}, then use a bounded writing loop for findings prose. The geographer verifies the complete report and presents the actual findings directly.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reports can repeat figure/reference placement and narrative drafting after analysis is complete.
tasks.enabler_now: Explicit artefact mappings and source-grounded writing suggestions support those particular report actions.
tasks.still_hard: Spatial patterns can be misrepresented as causes or described at an unsupported scale.
tasks.human_edge: The geographer explains the evidence and handles questions about scope and uncertainty.

ambition.what: Prepare checked explanations of actual findings for additional audiences.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: fixed map/table assembly and bounded evidence-based prose drafting can support geographic reports while verification and presentation remain human.

assumptions: Boundary includes the statement's actual report writing and oral presentation, not a separately transmitted or published report. Any real file send or publication needs the actual authority after the exact final version and its own gated action.
Actual findings and map/table production occur in the real research tasks and are counted there once. s1 counts actual evidence selection and verification, not a free new structured report pack.
s2 applies only to currently manual figure/table/reference assembly; test native report exports first and credit no existing automatic work.

s3 retains15 of25 narrative units, s4 retains15 full report-verification units and upkeep includes2 additional manual draft/assembly repair units. Ordinary working persistence is negligible within writing and carries no saving or self-approval.
s5 is a real oral presentation, not an automated dispatch or operative decision. Shares are unmeasured work estimates.
research_questions: Which assembly and narrative actions remain manual after existing geographic report tools?

already_counted.description: Actual evidence reading, retained narrative writing, full report checking and live presentation remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain report mappings/source tests3; manually repair failed assembly or drafts2.

Low: output metadata do not carry map scale/source fields, retaining14 of20 assembly units, and a complex uncertainty explanation retains22 of25 narrative units;6 plus3 saved less5 upkeep gives4. Full verification and oral presentation remain.

role.altitude: Source comparability, cartographic choice, geography teaching and research explanation remain human while explicit layer/report assembly can shrink.
reach: Work with actual source custodians on coordinate, date and geographic-unit provenance.
role.ambitious_version: A geographer who produces traceable working maps and reports with less repeated assembly while retaining field observation and scientific judgment.
